description: This file defines a helper class for logging, providing static methods to log messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper over Android's native Log utility and manages a chain of LogNode instances for log processing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging at various levels and manages LogNode chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode for forwarding log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards log message with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message or Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assertion failure or critical error with optional Throwable.
